international.title: UK embassy in Japan warns of rise in drink spiking and credit card fraud at Tokyo bars
international.summary: Social media campaign fronted by British rapper Shao Dow advises tourists not to let their guard down The British embassy in Tokyo has launched a social media campaign warning visitors to exercise caution after a rise in cases of drink-spiking and credit card fraud against tourists in the Japanese capital. In a recent clip made in conjunction with the embassy, the British rapper and manga artist Shao Dow, a frequent visitor to Japan, notes that although the country “is incredibly safe, that doesn’t mean you can let your guard down”.
